_note: The one place model IDs and prices live. Prices are US dollars per million tokens (prompts up to 100K tokens for Haiku), checked 2026-11-03; cache_read is the price of input read back from the prompt cache (a cache write costs 1.25 times input, spend.CACHE_WRITE). The app's spend cap reads these prices; check them against Anthropic's pricing page before relying on them, and change prices_checked when they are written down again.
